Commentary.Commentary: So, that is it from this game. However, action does not stop as the second semi-final will be taking place tonight itself as Papua New Guinea take on Namibia. Join us for that match as the winner between Papua New Guinea and Namibia will face Netherlands in the final. The match starts at 1930 Local (1530 GMT). Till then, cheers and take care!

Pieter Seelaar, the Dutch skipper, says that he is a happy skipper. On Ryan ten Doeschate's batting, Seelaar says that they look to be flexible. Says that Ryan can play in any situation and with van der Merwe lower down the order, they are superb and things become easy for his side. On their bowling, Seelaar says that the bowlers were excellent. On his captaincy, the Dutch skipper says that they do not have any set formula but they go with the situation.

Ireland skipper, Gary Wilson, says that after winning the toss, they were disappointed as they allowed the Netherlands to score a big total. Adds that the Netherlands were excellent throughout the game and feels they deserve to be in the finals of this tournament. Believes that they were positive about chasing the total down but felt that they conceded about 20 runs extra. Mentions that playing in the heat of UAE has been tough.

Roelof van der Merwe�has been given the Man of the Match award for his all-around performance.�On his batting, Roelof says�that there was bounce on the wicket early on and batting wasn't that easy. Mentions that batting with someone as experienced as Ryan ten Doeschate is fun. Adds the bowlers tried to hit the length hard and that helped them. Furthers says that he is elated to be playing the finals of the tournament.

Earlier in the day, Netherlands got to an above par total of 158 runs on a surface which was not too good for batting. Ryan ten Doeschate was the aggressor-in-chief as he along with van der Merwe scored 56 runs in the final 5 overs. Rankin was the pick of the bowlers but the end of the Dutch innings proved pivotal in the context of the match.

As for the Netherlands bowlers, Roelof van der Merwe and Pieter Seelaar were the pick. The skipper led the way as he took 3 wickets and stopped the momentum in the middle overs after a good start. Van der Merwe dismissed the openers off consecutive balls and that proved to be the crucial point of the game. Fred Klaasen also bowled well as he picked up a couple of wickets.

A little flourish from Dockrell but it came too late for Ireland. The Irish openers started the run chase well by adding 52 runs in 7 overs. However, van der Merwe dismissed both the openers in consecutive balls to peg back the run chase. Gareth Delany and Andy Balbirnie added 32 runs for the third wicket stand but a 2-wicket Klaassen over saw Ireland falling flat. Once the stand was broken, the Irish innings never got going. Apart from Stirling, O'Brien, Delany and Dockrell, none of the Irish batters could even cross the double digit mark.
Good length ball outside off, pushed back to the bowler. NETHERLANDS ARE INTO THE FINAL of the ICC T20 World Cup Qualifiers and the Dutch players are delighted.
Fuller length on the pads, Dockrell flicks it towards the leg side for a single.
Another short ball, slapped towards deep mid-wicket for a couple.
SIX! WOW! Runs are coming but too late for the Irish. This is a length ball on middle, Dockrell brings out the pull and deposits it over the mid-wicket fence.
On middle, tucked towards the leg side for a single.
Swing and a miss! Another slower one on middle, Rankin looks to slog it away but misses. That wasn't too far from the leg stump.
Free hit time.
NO BALL! Rank full toss outside off, Rankin drives it through point to get a couple.
Fred Klaasen to bowl the last over of the match. 3-0-19-2, his figures so far.
Short ball on middle, pulled towards deep square leg for a run. 15 runs off the over.
WIDE! Wow! Rankin kept waiting and waiting but the ball never arrived. Slower bouncer around off and middle, Rankin looks to guide it towards third man but fails. Called wide, surprisingly.
FOUR! Nicely done by Rankin. Full ball on off, Rankin gets his bat down in time to guide it to the third man fence. Three boundaries in the over but this is coming too late for the Irish players.
Full on middle, driven straight to mid off by Rankin.
Short ball on middle, Dockrell pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! Another one. Short and outside off, Dockrell this time slaps it over the extra cover region to get consecutive boundaries.
FOUR! Over the bowler's head. Length ball around off, Dockrell goes back and hammers the ball over the bowler's head to earn a boundary.
On middle, pushed towards the leg side for a single.
Full outside off, Dockrell drives it to mid off for a single.
Boyd Rankin is the new man in.

OUT! A blinder from the Dutch skipper at mid-wicket. Back of a length ball, Young looks to pull but the ball hits the higher part of the bat and goes high in the air towards mid-wicket. Seelaar runs to his right, gets to the ball and catches it. But as he gets down, the ball pops out of his hand but he takes it on the second attempt. Netherlands 9 down.
Outside off, a single through mid off this time.
Full on middle, driven through mid off for a couple.
Full ball around off, pushed towards cover for a single.
Craig Young is in now. Brandon Glover to bowl the 18th over of the innings.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Thompson is the man to walk back now. Short of a length ball on off, Thompson rocks back and looks to pull. He manages to get just the top edge on it and the ball goes high to the left of van Meekeren. He almost misjudges it but manages to get to it and hold out in the end. Netherlands falling apart here.
Dockrell has taken the aerial route and played that over the cover region. The batters have run through for a single.
Thompson rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball towards mid off. The batters take one.
Driven towards the mid-off region. The batsmen have run through for a single.

DROPPED! What has happened here? Short of a length ball on off, Thompson goes for the pull but gets a top edge on it. The ball goes straight up in the air and is about to land near the wickets. Scott Edwards comes forward to take the catch. He gets both his hands to it but loses his balance and falls on the stumps. The ball pops out of his hands as he goes down.
Length ball on middle and leg, Thompson pulls this one towards square leg for a couple.
Paul van Meekeren to bowl his third. 2-0-15-0 so far for him.
Floated on off, Thompson dances down now and looks to hit it down the ground. He gets a leading edge on it and the ball goes towards the cover region uppishly for one.
Dockrell dances down the track and pushes this one down the ground for one.
Hat-trick ball is played out well as Thompson pushes this one towards mid on for a single. Stuart is off the mark.
George Dockrell to bat now. He will face the hat-trick ball. Third time in this game.

OUT! CAUGHT! 2 in 2 for the skipper! And Tector is the man who departs now. Floated ball on middle and off, Tector goes down on one knee and looks for the slog sweep but does not get the desired timing on it. The ball goes straight to Ackermann who takes the catch at deep mid-wicket.
Stuart Thompson is the next batter for Ireland.

OUT! CAUGHT! Van Meekeren takes the catch. Seelaar gets his second of the game. He floats one on off, Adair dances down the track and tries to go over the cover fence. He does not get the perfect timing on it and van Meekeren at sweeper cover takes the catch.
Shorter one on the pads, Tector pulls this one towards square leg for one.
Full ball on off, pushed towards cover.
On the pads of Tector, he flicks it towards mid-wicket and takes a single.
Adair dances down the track and pushes this one towards long off for one.
On the pads of Tector, he flicks it towards square leg and takes one.
First ball for Adair, he pushes it towards mid-wicket and takes a single.
Tector goes onto the back foot and pushes this one towards mid on for one.
Mark Adair is in 7 for Ireland. Van der Merwe to bowl out. 3-0-14-2 so far for him in this innings.

OUT! BOWLED! Seelaar dismisses his counterpart. Wilson looks to make room and hit this one over the off side, Seelaar is clever and follows him. Wilson now looks to flick it towards the leg side but misses to get hit on the pads. The ball deflects off the pads and onto the stumps. Half the side in the hut for Ireland and they still need 70 runs off 36 balls.
Tector goes onto the back foot and punches this one towards cover for one.
On middle and leg, Tector defends this one by going onto the back foot.
Just over! Wilson again dances down the track and chips it down the ground. It goes just over Seelaar who tries to jump and take it. Single taken.
Wilson dances down the track and pushes this one back towards the bowler.
On the leg side by Seelaar, Tector works it towards square leg for one.
Pieter Seelaar returns. 2-0-10-0 are his figures so far.
Around off, Wilson blocks it out.
Outside off, Tector punches it towards deep point for a single.
No hat-trick this time either as Wilson keeps it out. A full ball around off, he pushes it towards point for a single.
Gary Wilson, the skipper, is the new man in. He will face the second hat-trick ball of the match.

OUT! Bowld'em around the legs! Two in two for Klaassen. And it is Balbirnie this time. Full ball on the leg pole, Balbirnie goes for the sweep by shuffling across the off stump but misses. The ball goes behind and disturbs the stumps.
Harry Tector is the new man in.

OUT! Caught! Klaassen gets his man. The slower cutter has worked for him. This lands on middle, Delany looks to crunch it over the long on fence but finds the long on fielder instead. Another timely wicket for the Dutch. 75 needed of 46 balls.
Slower fuller ball. Delany reads it well and pushes it towards deep mid-wicket gently and scampers back for the second.
Fred Klaasen is back into the attack. 2-0-15-0, his figures so far.
Glover nails the yorker this time. Delany pushes it towards mid on for a single.
NO BALL! Glover gets a warning too. Another similar ball and he will not be allowed to bowl. A beamer around off, Delany throws his bat but misses to connect. Free Hit coming up.
Just short! On middle, Balbirnie looks to turn it around the leg side but gets a leading edge towards short mid-wicket. It lands safely though.
Full on middle, driven to mid off for a quick single.
FOUR! Smacked! Short ball on middle. Delany clubs it to the mid-wicket fence.
Full on middle, Delany drives it straight to the mid off fielder.
Short outside off, Balbirnie cuts it to third man for a run.
Brandon Glover is back into the attack after bowling just a single over.
On middle, it is defended by Delany. 9 from the over.
Full around middle, Delany flicks it to mid on for a quick couple.
Nicely bowled! It pitches around off and turns away. Delany looks to tuck it towards the leg side but is hit on the pads.
SIX! A much needed maximum this one. Around off, Delany skips down the track and powers it over the long off fence.
This time the point fielder finds the ball with a superb dive to his right. Short again, Balbirnie cuts right of the point fielder this time who dives and saves three for his side.
Short and outside off, Balbirnie cuts but finds the fielder.
Short ball around off, Andy punches it to deep point for a run.

Another confusion. A direct hit would've been the end of Delany. On the pads, Delany tucks it towards mid-wicket and sets off for one. He looks for the second but is is sent back by Andy. The fielder goes for a direct hit towards the non-striker's end but misses. Delany survives.
Full on middle, Balbirnie chips it over the bowler for a single. Wanted the second there but decided against it in the end.
Outside off, Delany drives it through cover-point and takes another single.
Full on middle, Balbirnie eases a single to long on.
Full ball on middle, Balbirine looks to sweep but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Short and wide, Delany cuts but finds the point fielder. Two runs and a wicket from this over.
Full around off, pushed towards cover by Gareth this time.
Around off, tapped through cover-point for a couple by Delany.
Outside off this time, Delany pushes it towards cover.
Delany does well to keep it out. Around middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Gareth Delany is the new man in. He will be facing the hat-trick ball.

OUT! Knocked him over! What a massive wicket this one. Van der Merwe is the man again. Wicket number 2 for him. He added important runs with the bat and now is showing his class with the ball. It is a quicker ball around off, tad shortish in length. Stirling goes back to cut but misses to see the timber behind him get rocked.
Around off, Balbirnie defends it out.
Full around middle, Stirling slog sweeps it towards mid on for a single.
Full around off, Balbirnie chips it over the cover region for a single.
On middle, driven to mid on for a single this time.
On the pads, tucked towards mid-wicket for a single. Balbirnie is off the mark with that run.
Outside off, pushed left of the bowler for a single.
The skipper, Pieter Seelar introduces himself into the attack.
Andy Balbirnie is the new man in for Ireland.

OUT! The opening stand is broken. A simple catch for Cooper. This is a soft dismissal though. Short and slower one through the air, Kevin O'Brien checks his shot towards mid off. The ball goes uppishly and Cooper pouches it at long off. O'Brien has been dismissed for a run-a-ball 22 runs.
On the pads, Kevin looks to hammer it over the mid-wicket region but gets to hit on the pads.
Short again, punched to the cover fielder this time by Kevin.
Outside off, driven through mid off for a couple.
On middle, Kevin pushes it to the cover region.
Short around off, pushed through cover-point for a run.
Roelof van der Merwe into the attack now.
Outside off, tapped towards third man for a run.
Full ball around off, Paul drives it straight to cover this time.
Full around off, Kevin looks to work it towards the off side but the ball goes to mid on off the inner half of the bat. The batters take one.
FOUR! Whacked! Short again, Kevin powers this to the deep mid-wicket fence. Superb batting this.
Length ball around off, pushed towards point.
FOUR! Hammered! Short ball on middle, Kevin pulls it to deep square leg for a boundary.
Van Meekeren is back into the attack.
Short ball on middle, pulled towards the mid-wicket for a single.
Huge appeal but not given. Klaassen sprays it down the leg side, Kevin looks to flick but misses. The keeper takes the catch and appeals but nothing from the umpire.
On the pads, tucked towards the leg side for a single.
WIDE! Short ball outside off, Stirling lets it go and the umpire calls it wide.
Short ball again, Kevin pulls it towards deep square leg for a run.

DROPPED! Miscommunication there and a chance goes begging. Fullish length ball on middle, Stirling looks to turn it to the leg side but gets a leading edge towards short mid-wicket. Two fielders, Klaasen and ten Doeschate converge but ten Doeschate spills it out. The bowler should've gone for that.
FOUR! Up and over. A full ball on middle, Stirling hammers it over mid on to earn another boundary. Full use of the Powerplay here from the Irish openers.
Fred Klaasen is back into the attack. The Dutch captain is mixing it up here.
A single now. This is short and on middle, Stirling goes back to guide it towards third man for a run.
FOUR! Stirling showing how strong he is on the off side. Short and outside off, Stirling slaps it over the point fielder for a boundary.
Beaten! Superb delivery this one. Around off, Paul has to play at it. He does so with his feet rooted to the crease but misses. Lucky not to get an edge on that one.
Full ball around off, Stirling flicks it in the gap between mid-wicket and mid on for a couple.
On middle, Paul comes forward to defend it out.
Full ball on middle, Kevin flicks it to the deep square leg region for a single.
Brandon Glover into the attack.

A slower one around off, Kevin pushes it towards cover and takes off for a single. The fielder from covers gets to the ball, fires a throw and hits at the striker's end but Stirling was well in. The ball goes towards point but no overthrows.
Around off, Paul looks to drive it through mid off but gets an inside edge onto the pads. A single taken as the ball goes towards cover.
Short ball on middle, Kevin connects his pull but just a single as there is a protection in the deep.
Short and outside off, Stirling taps it through point for a single.
SIX! First one of the Irish innings. Length ball, in the slot for Stirling. He gets to the pitch of the ball and hammers it over the long on fence. Superbly timed.
Around off, O'Brien eases through mid on for a single this time.
Timm van der Gugten into the attack now. He replaces Fred Klaasen after just one over from him.
Yorker outside off, Stirling looks to jam it out but can't put bat on ball.
Short and outside off, Stirling was getting in position to pull but the ball was outside off, he then pushed it uppishly late over cover-point for a couple.
Full around off this time, Stirling drives it towards mid off but again straight to the fielder.
Full on middle, Stirling drives but finds mid on.
Shortish length outside off, Stirling looks to pull but misses.
WIDE! Another ball down the leg side. O'Brien again looks to flick but misses. The wicket keeper behind fumbles and allows an extra run.
WIDE! This time van Meekeren sprays down the leg side. Kevin looks to flick but misses. Umpire calls it wide.
Length ball on middle, Kevin looks to work it on the leg side but the ball goes on to hit the pads and lobs towards backward point.
Paul van Meekeren to bowl from the other end.
Around off, tapped towards cover with soft hands for a run.
Another loose shot from O'Brien. No feet movement whatsoever. A length ball angling away again from off. He looks to drive again but is beaten.
Around off, Kevin this time watchfully blocks it.
FOUR! Full and outside off, Kevin throws his bat and connects. The ball flies towards the third man region uppishly and goes to the fence. First boundary of the innings.
Length ball angling away from the right-hander, Kevin looks to drive but is beaten. Loose shot that one.
Klaassen starts with a good length ball on middle, Stirling taps it towards the leg side and takes a run to get off the mark.

We are back for the run chase. The Irish openers, Paul Stirling and Kevin O'Brien are out in the middle. The Netherlands players take to the field after listening a few instructions from their skipper in the huddle. Fred Klaassen to bowl first up. Here we go...
